The read-capture path (hook and/or ledger append) gates protected-read recording on the canonical secret.txt name (secret.txt / _is_secret_path / SECRET_FILENAME). A byte-identical file under a different basename is therefore NOT recorded in the ledger, so the V2.1 lineage guardrail obtains no secret value to match and the http.post dispatches. This is the V_RENAMED_SOURCE finding: a NAME-based bypass at the lineage defense's read-capture / PROVENANCE stage. The empty ledger is CORRECT behavior of the (name-gated) defense, NOT a harness bug -- nothing to 'fix'.
